conformal_abstention.note: Risk-controlled abstention; not a probability transform.

caveats: Predictive confidence is not proof of correctness.
Confidence values are heuristic blends, not posterior probabilities; post-hoc transforms can reduce ECE without improving decision quality.
Retrieval substitutions are scored on retrieval confidence, not answer confidence.

reproducibility.note: Systems under test (EXP-I/EXP-J) are imported read-only.
